chapter: Records, dances and Blanche Calloway (repeated passages)
title: Playing for dances: tempo and the dancers' feet
summary: Dance tempos stayed fixed because the shuffling feet held a rushing drummer back, and good dancers influenced his playing.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Did you enjoy playing for dancers?
Sure. I used to enjoy it very much.
Doesn't it tend to affect the... Playing for dancing certainly would affect things like tempos and so on..

When we were playing for dances, I think the tempos stayed pretty well fixed. Because the dancers keep that going. You can hear the feet, the shuffling of the feet, and the... Because if the drummer gets too fast, the people will still hold him down with the shuffle of them feet, you know -- if he's one of them fast drummers that gets excited, you know.
Yeah. Those people... The sound of them feet are holding him back, you know.
Could it also be sometimes that if you were watching some really good dancers while you were playing, that it would make you play in a different way?
